channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: War on Iran: Phase II, Day 37
item.description: Iran is offering $30,000 for captured or killed US soldiers. Trump cuts back South Korea drills.

item.title: Somali army clashes with rebel forces for control of key city Baidoa
item.description: Somali forces repel rebel fighters in Baidoa after intense fighting involving explosives and dozens of casualties.

item.title: Trump says US in contact with IRGC and calls on Iran to surrender
item.description: President also claims US is in direct contact with IRGC, denies a rush to end conflict ahead of November's US midterms.

item.title: Iran signals readiness for ‘US ground operations’ as strategy shifts gear
item.description: Iran's more offensive posture follows Trump's comment that the US would soon make the Strait of Hormuz its territory.

item.title: Yemen’s drone war: Rivals flex growing aerial muscle
item.description: Houthi and government forces exchange drone attacks, marking a major shift in war tactics.

item.title: Trump scales down war games with South Korea: Why it matters
item.description: US president cites Seoul's reluctance to back his war on Iran, and his warm ties with North Korea's leader as reasons.

item.title: US-Iran Memorandum of Understanding expires: How and why it fell apart
item.description: Trump deemed the MoU 'over' within a month of it being signed, as the two sides traded attacks despite a 'ceasefire'.

item.title: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
item.description: Trump's threat on Oman, which has been holding its own talks with Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, comes as a 60-day window for peace negotiations expires.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine trade more deadly strikes
item.description: Moscow says nine people have been killed in the past 24 hours, while Kyiv reports four deaths.

item.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
item.description: Trump cites his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader in deciding to downsize the exercises.
